scope.summary: Windows durable-state 'Access is denied' (os error 5) fixed: every durable append (write-intent log, metrics, source history) is opened readably so authenticate_private_file can inspect the descriptor. On Windows the number_of_links read is the windows_by_handle path (GetFileInformationByHandleEx/FileStandardInfo), which needs FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES; an append-only open (FILE_GENERIC_WRITE & !FILE_WRITE_DATA) lacked that right, so the pre-write inspection failed ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. The append handle is now opened with the read-attributes right.
out_of_scope: the earlier feature-gate compile fix (a84b29d) that made the windows_by_handle path compile

entry_points.name: durable-append handle open + authenticate_private_file
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-core/src/file_store.rs: open_append_private_file now opens the durable-append handle with FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES so authenticate_private_file's metadata()/number_of_links() inspection succeeds before the first write. Fix landed in 1030b6dc. The os-error-5 only reproduces on Windows; the Windows CI lane is the authoritative verifier.
